scope: v0.26.5 RC1 attempt 14 supersedes attempt 13. It keeps the user-verified Sony Raw-HID native streaming controller backend and introduces one unified Windows pointer experience: HuymaierUnifiedCursorHost.exe replaces Windows standard cursor shapes with the gold Huymaier circle while Huymaier Console or its curated native streaming interfaces own the experience, eliminating the white Windows arrow over the Huymaier cursor. WebView controller movement no longer uses the JavaScript virtual-cursor motion path; Web content uses the same real OS pointer, Raw-HID/GameInput radial 2-D left-stick movement, right-stick scrolling, A/Cross click, X/Square keyboard and shared 40-200% cursor speed as native streaming apps. Native streaming fullscreen first requests the app-native fullscreen shortcut, then strips standard and extended window chrome, disables DWM non-client rendering and forces the root window to monitor bounds; global PS/Guide Game Bar behavior over external native apps remains preserved. Active provider/storefront Install/Update telemetry must never rebuild Games: provider-transfers.json does not invalidate ProviderStatePath, Downloads progress cards update in place, provider catalog mutation is deferred, and a successful terminal install/update schedules one coalesced library refresh after completion. The generic v0.26.5 staged gate has been corrected to require this completion-only policy and explicitly reject the obsolete aggregate-telemetry library invalidation bridge. Preserve Wii/GameCube hidden artwork aliases with pretty display names, Dolphin save/artwork integration, curated Apps/app artwork, concurrent transfers/ETA/history retention, hitch guards, compiled 0.26.5/x64 stamp, installer rollback/tamper, Steam ownership, Nintendo ownership and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 presentation. Upload only if the generic stabilization gate and staged unifiedSystemCursorGate, nativeWebPointerGate, nativeStreamingChromeSuppressionGate, activeDownloadLibraryStabilityGate, completionOnlyLibraryRefreshGate and inPlaceDownloadTelemetryGate all succeed together with prior Sony HID, Game Bar, Wii alias, provider, installer and freeze gates.
